To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we present a method to compute eigenmodes of the dynamo problem that is more efficient than the classical treatment based the biorthogonalities of the magnetic field with its adjoint, which is based on the integration of the induction equation with respect to time.

we present a method for computing the eigensolutions and eigenvalues of the dynamo problem that is much more efficient than the classical method and that the results are in good agreement with the results of the classical method.
we have presented an elegant and efficient method of determining the eigenfunctions of dynamo equations in fluid flows.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a generalization of the classical treatment of the induction equation and its adjoint in the case of a velocity field which is not divergence-free.
the eigenfunctions and eigenfrequencies of the induction and magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) dynamo equations in spherical geometry.
the determination of the eigenfunctions of induction and dynamo equation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the method presented here is a useful tool for determining the dynamo eigenfunctions, especially when the coefficients of the dynamo equations are not known in closed analytical form.
the new method is a powerful tool in the study of the geodynamos.
the method presented here is an elegant and very efficient tool for computing the eigensolutions and eigenvalues of the induction and of the dynamo equations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have developed an efficient method to compute the eigenfunctions of a dynamo.
the new method is very efficient and accurate for determining the eigenfunctions and eigenvalues of the induction and of the dynamo equations.
the new method is a powerful tool to calculate the eigensolutions and eigenvalues of the induction and/or dynamo equations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the method of adjoint biorthogonaliy is an effective tool for determining the eigenfunctions of induction and dynamo problems.
the new approach based on biorthogonaliy is more efficient and more robust for computing the eigenvalues and eigensolutions of dynamos.
the new method is more efficient and can produce results that are in good agreement with the classical method.
